text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Runnymede Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Runnymede Road.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Runnymede Road, between a point 58.3 metres north of St John's Road and a point 5.5 metres further north.
